responsibility: This definition file is the master table of GCC branch predictors. For each heuristic it specifies the predictor enum name, dump/debug name, expected hitrate, and flags such as first-match behavior, covering generic, loop, built-in-expect, call, opcode, and Fortran-specific predictors. It is consumed to generate predictor enums, metadata tables, and combination behavior in the branch prediction subsystem.
same_name_distinction: Serves as the master X-macro list of branch predictors, their names, hit rates, and flags, rather than implementing prediction logic like predict.cc or exposing callable APIs like predict.h.
